ORIGIN.quote: Are the "OpenAI" names spoofable? Yes; vendor attribution rests only on Azure egress and phrasing, so treat it as Medium confidence, the agentic nature of the traffic as High.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing that OpenAI is the vendor hypothesis on the table — the report explicitly frames the self-identifying names, Azure egress and phrasing as bearing on vendor attribution and assigns it Medium confidence rather than dismissing it, and it repeatedly flags the 650 OpenAI/OAI usernames and Azure hosting as evidence about who was running the fleet. It stays below 0.8 because the OpenAI attribution is never stated as the leading or most plausible source in the report's own voice — it appears only as a hedged caveat tucked into "Alternatives considered" — but it sits above 0.6 because that caveat still leaves OpenAI standing as the sole named vendor hypothesis at Medium confidence rather than merely one option among several.
